name: Amber Kearnen
summary: Amber Kearnen is a sharp-eyed operative of SI:7 stationed deep in Westfall. From her concealed vantage point overlooking the plains, she monitors the illicit activities of the Defias Brotherhood on behalf of Master Mathias Shaw.

sections.title: Eyes on the Tower
sections.body: An agent of SI:7, Amber Kearnen serves as one of Stormwind's field scouts. Rather than walking the halls of Stormwind Keep, she operates under the open skies of Westfall, watching over an abandoned watchtower commandeered by the Defias Brotherhood. Under the direct leadership of Master Mathias Shaw, Kearnen provides critical oversight and briefing for covert operatives sent to neutralize Defias threats and gather intelligence across the contested countryside.

sections.title: A Deadly Assignment
sections.body: Her vigilance is concentrated on Klaven Mortwake, a Defias who has holed up in the watchtower southeast of Sentinel Hill. After weeks of staking out the tower, Kearnen briefs infiltrating rogues on the strange, inhuman guards that arrived with a shipment from Duskwood, sending them to steal the tower key, break inside and uncover the contents of the Duskwood chest, including Klaven's journal. Her patience and careful notes make her indispensable to the Crown's shadow operations against the Defias.

faq.answer: Amber Kearnen is an operative of SI:7, Stormwind's elite intelligence division. She serves as a field agent and scout, currently tasked with tracking Defias operations in Westfall.

faq.q: Where can Amber Kearnen be found?
faq.answer: She is positioned in the wilds of Westfall, keeping watch near the abandoned Alliance watchtower occupied by the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What is her connection to Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: She answers directly to Master Mathias Shaw, the leader of SI:7. Shaw sends fellow agents to her in Westfall for debriefing on Defias activity there.

faq.q: What role does she play in Klaven's Tower?
aliases: what does she do at the tower
faq.answer: Kearnen monitors the watchtower held by Klaven Mortwake. She briefs Alliance rogues dispatched by SI:7, providing the tactical oversight needed to slip inside, bypass Defias guards, and retrieve Klaven's journal.

angles.text: For Alliance rogues proving their tradecraft, Agent Kearnen serves as your primary contact in the field, helping coordinate the infiltration of Klaven's Tower.
Kearnen represents Stormwind's proactive covert wing, working behind enemy lines in Westfall to undermine the Defias Brotherhood without alarming the populace.
